chunks: When we are dead and turned to dust and bones, how can we be raised again?
ai.seo_question: What was the polytheists' objection to resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse captures the polytheists' materialistic skepticism regarding bodily resurrection, questioning how decayed dust and bones can be revived. In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical challenge is often contrasted with the divine power to recreate, emphasizing that resurrection is not merely a return to the physical state but a restoration of the soul's connection to the body. The verse serves as a foundational argument for the reality of the Hereafter against those who deny it based on observable physical decay.
